name: tracker-follow-through-shpe9k
goal: Replay item chasing, unattended work admission, and unanswered asks through the native Tracker lifecycle

evidence: The native CLI must persist chase history across sync and finish, keep capacity-held work queued, and ask again on the Lisbon schedule.
Existing CLI replay lacked chase and completion assertions, host-capacity fixture only used prequeued items, and direct-reminder fixture tested hourly retries.
